items.headline: Phillips, South Alabama ground game helps churn 41-36 win over Ohio
items.description: — Jared Hollis threw for 192 yards and a touchdown. Keenan Phillips ran for a 116 yards and a touchdown and South Alabama beat Ohio 41-36 on Saturday night.
